title: draft-kondoju-evc-01 - An External Verifier Contract for Agent Authorization Decisions
snippet: IETF Internet-Draft by V. P. Kondoju specifying the External Verifier Contract (EVC): a small, testable, proof-system-agnostic boundary between a host about to take a privileged action on an agent's behalf and an external verifier subprocess that renders a fail-closed allow/deny verdict on an opaque proof bundle.
